0022600180.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-2, 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, 4th in the East) head to Oklahoma City on a one-game winning streak, with a 1-2 road record, while the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-2, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, 6th in the West) have dropped their last two games but are 3-0 at home. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), both listed as out. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and the Cavaliers lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026, with no games yet between the teams this season.
